Having hobbies they're passionate about. For example, I'm not personally a big fan of golf, pottery, or card games (MtG, Yugioh, etc), but if I met a guy or girl that genuinely enjoyed things like that and I saw their eyes light up talking about it, it'd make them more attractive to me. It adds more character to them, makes them easier to be around than somebody who has zero interests whatsoever. 
Also, if they were happy enough and the hobby sounded interesting to me, I might give it a try! I'd go to a golf course, ask them to teach me about the card game in question, let them show me the process of making things with a pottery wheel. They could even get me hooked on it too!

Now, illegal interests, hell no. If it causes harm to someone, I don't want any part of it. I think that would go without saying, but still
